name: Knorr
ingredients_raw: NOODLES: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Thickener - 1420, Palm Oil/Palmolein, Wheat Gluten, Potato Starch, Iodised Salt, Yeast, Acidity Regulator - 500(i) and 501(i), Texturizer - 451(i). SEASONING: Sugar, Flavour Enhancer - 627 & 631, Iodised Salt, Food Colour - Caramel I, Potato Starch, Flavours - Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Soya Sauce), Dehydrated Vegetables (Garlic (0.8%), Ginger), Chilli Powder (0.9%), Hydrogenated Palm Oil, Anticaking Agent - 551, Maltodextrin, Oleoresin Chillies, Acidity Regulator-330. Dehydrated Vegetables (2.7%): Cabbage, Spring Onion, Mushroom, Broccoli, Bell Pepper, Zucchini.
